meta.notes: Market value at fiscal year-end (all share classes); historical names hand-checked

sky: Morgan Stanley Dean Witter D & C

data.source_line: Source: CRSP via WRDS. US-incorporated common stocks; company market value each December (September 2026 for the last year).
data.date_note: December month-end values, all listed share classes plus non-trading classes at the same price; 2026 uses month-end prices for 2026-09.

intangibles.label: Intangible assets as a share of shareholders' equity, average US public company
intangibles.definition: Compustat North America fundamentals annual (industrial, standard, consolidated), US-incorporated companies (FIC = USA), all industries including financials. Ratio = intangible assets (INTAN) ÷ common equity (CEQ) where both are reported and CEQ is not zero; winsorized at the 1% and 99% percentiles of all firm-years FY1970-2025; unweighted mean by fiscal year.
intangibles.source_line: Source: Compustat via WRDS. US-incorporated public companies; intangible assets ÷ common shareholders' equity, winsorized 1%/99%, mean by fiscal year.
